The chip style feels natural, so I’d keep it. As I type, though, I’d like it to suggest tags I’ve already used so I can pick one instead of accidentally creating slightly different versions.

A few corrections to the editor:

- I should be able to edit the web address as well as the title, description, note, and tags.
- Clicking the bookmark’s title or card should open the original page. Please give me a separate, obvious Edit action to open this editor.
- Since notes may contain things like links or short lists, I’d like simple Markdown formatting to display properly when the note is shown.

The duplicate-link behavior opening this editor directly is exactly right.
